$description: Mubu interface design tokens (DTCG 2025.10). Source of truth for the app's own UI only: demos keep their own styles. Run `npm run tokens` after editing.

palette.$description: Primitive colors. Never used directly by components: semantic tokens alias them.

note-dark.$description: Dark-mode note fills: deep tints of the light ones, so light note text reads at 7:1 or better.

color.$description: Semantic colors. Each has a light value and a dark mode value.

canvas.$description: Page and canvas background: a warm light gray (#E8E7E1) in light mode, a soft charcoal (#252525) in dark mode rather than near-black.

canvas-dot.$description: Dot grid on the canvas: about 1.75:1 against the canvas in both modes, visible but quieter than any content.

surface.$description: Cards, panels, inputs on the canvas.

field.$description: Inside text inputs, selects and segmented controls.

border.$description: Default 1px borders and dividers. High contrast: at least 3:1 against surfaces and the canvas in both modes, so every box and control has a visible edge.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text, labels, hints. High contrast: at least 4.5:1 on surfaces and on the canvas.

text-on-accent.$description: Text on accent or danger fills.

note.$description: Sticky note fills: light pastels, and deep tints of the same hues in dark mode (with light note text).

mono.$description: Code and numbers that must align.

zalando-sans.$description: Reading text on the canvas (text boxes, notes, the reader); bundled with @fontsource-variable/zalando-sans.

jetbrains-mono.$description: The canvas panel's font; bundled with @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono.

handjet.$description: Label font option: a dot-matrix display face; bundled with @fontsource-variable/handjet (weights 100–900).

instrument-serif.$description: Label font option: a condensed display serif; bundled with @fontsource/instrument-serif (regular weight only, so heavier weights are synthesized).

space.$description: Spacing scale for padding, gaps and margins. Names are the pixel value.

raised.$description: Floating panels, cards on hover, demo frames.

subtle.$description: A very light lift for boxes on the canvas.

zoom.$description: Zooming a text box into and out of the reader.

zoom-out.$description: Zooming a text box back out of the reader: a little quicker than zooming in.

theme.$description: Switching between light and dark: the new theme grows as an ellipse from the bottom-right corner. With the browser's ~60 ms snapshot before it starts, the whole switch takes about 600 ms.

slide.$description: Sliding from one canvas to the next.

theme.$description: The theme ellipse starts slowly and speeds up until it fills the screen.

zoom-out.$description: Zooming back out of the reader: starts right away and settles onto the box, with a shorter tail than the standard curve.

slide.$description: Symmetric ease for two canvases moving together.

control.$description: Default height of buttons and inputs.

node-adornment.$description: Selection tags and handles above node content.

controls.$description: Floating controls: canvas switcher and theme switch.

viewer.$description: Spread-out stack view and its backdrop, above controls.

theme-switch.$description: Theme switch: above the reader and stack viewer.

component.$description: Component-level tokens. They alias semantic tokens so components can be restyled one at a time.

outline.$description: Selected node outline and corner handles.

bar-height.$description: Title bar of a demo frame; also the drag handle.

page-bg.$description: Behind the demo iframe, before the page paints.

label.$description: Shape labels sit on light fills, so they stay dark in both modes.

drag-strip-height.$description: Edit mode: the strip along the top of a video that moves the node.

drag-strip-shade.$description: Top of the strip's shade, fading to transparent.

text.$description: Note text: dark on the light fills, light on the dark-mode fills.

padding.$description: Space inside a note on every side.

shadow.$description: Lifts the note off the canvas like paper.

rich-text.$description: Rich text in text nodes and notes.

display-scale.$description: ⌘1 or # — Display, relative to the node's text size.

headline-scale.$description: ⌘2 or ## — Headline, relative to the node's text size.

subheader-scale.$description: ⌘3 or ### — Subheader, relative to the node's text size.

block-gap.$description: Space after paragraphs, headings and lists.

highlight.$description: ⇧⌘E marker. Translucent amber so it reads on white, dark and every note color.

theme-switch.$description: Light/dark switch fixed to the bottom-right corner.

inset.$description: Distance from the window's bottom and right edges.

code.$description: Code blocks. Syntax colors come from Shiki's GitHub light and dark themes, not tokens.

switcher.$description: Canvas switcher, fixed to the bottom-left corner.

inset.$description: Distance from the window's bottom and left edges.

stack.$description: Image stacks: a pile of slightly rotated prints.

frame.$description: Print border around each image; stays white in dark mode, like paper.

badge-bg.$description: Image count pill; inverts with the theme.

stack-viewer.$description: The spread-out view of a stack over a blurred, grayed-out canvas.

padding.$description: Padding on top, left and right as a share of the text box's width (10%); none at the bottom, where long text is clipped.

reader.$description: Full-screen reader that a text box zooms up into.

top.$description: Space above the text, below the back button.

width-ratio.$description: Text width as a share of the canvas area the reader fills (half).

min-width.$description: On narrow windows the text never gets narrower than this (or the window minus the gutters).

inset.$description: Back button distance from the top-left corner.

selection.$description: Text selection for visitors: a subtle gray.

scrollbar.$description: Overlay scrollbar (thumb only, no track) used in the full-screen reader.

inset.$description: Distance from the window's right, top and bottom edges.

hide-delay.$description: The thumb fades out this long after scrolling stops.

rotate-handle.$description: Edit mode: the round handle above a selected note that rotates it.

offset.$description: Distance from the box's top edge to the handle's centre.

hover-lift.$description: View mode: interactive boxes (text, video, demo, stack) grow slightly on hover to show they respond to clicks.

node.$description: Shared by boxes on the canvas.

shadow.$description: Text boxes, code blocks, images, videos and demos (notes and stack prints have their own).

border.$description: Edge of every box on the canvas (high contrast): text, notes, code, images, videos, demos, web pages and stack prints.

shape-shadow.$description: Shapes use a drop-shadow filter in this color so the shadow follows their outline.

label.$description: Labels: text with no box, in a choice of fonts.

padding.$description: Small inset so the selection outline doesn't touch the letters.

canvas-slide.$description: While switching canvases, each canvas casts a shadow so they read as separate sheets, not one canvas scrolling.

spinner.$description: Circling ring over an image or video while it loads.

track.$description: The faint full ring the arc runs along.

canvas-text.$description: Experiment (jetbrains-mono branch): JetBrains Mono for short text on the canvas, Zalando Sans for reading.

font.$description: Short text on the canvas: labels (overriding their own font choice), shape and connector labels, code, link cards and box titles.

reading-font.$description: Text that's read in full: text boxes, notes and the full-screen reader. A proportional sans reads more easily than mono in paragraphs.

canvas-reveal.$description: Around the pointer, the canvas's dots morph into + − × ÷ (each grid point always shows the same symbol), and back to dots as it moves away. Strong enough to notice for visitors, barely there in the editor.

radius.$description: Reach around the pointer, on screen (visitors).

symbol-size.$description: A symbol's width at the pointer, as a multiple of the dot's diameter (visitors): about 11px at 100% zoom, and it scales with zoom exactly like the dots.

symbol-size-edit.$description: Smaller symbols in the editor (about 9px at 100%), drawn in the dot color rather than the stronger reveal color.

stroke.$description: Symbol line thickness as a multiple of the dot's diameter, so symbols carry about the same visual weight as the dots at every zoom.

fade-out.$description: Settling back to dots after the pointer stops, leaves, or a drag starts.

follow.$description: How much of the way to the pointer the reveal moves each frame (lower trails more softly).

loading-bar.$description: Thin bar along the top of the canvas area while a canvas loads (switching canvases): it creeps toward the end while the map and its images load, then finishes and fades.

color.$description: A bright red, the same in both modes.

creep.$description: Time to creep to 90% while waiting; it never reaches the end until loading is done.

finish.$description: Running to the end and fading out once the canvas is ready.

canvas-panel.$description: Left panel listing every canvas as a snapshot of its last view and its title.

width-ratio.$description: Share of the window width (a fifth).

min-width.$description: Floor on narrow windows, so snapshots and titles stay legible.

collapsed-ratio.$description: Share of the window width still showing when the panel is tucked away (a fifteenth).

slide.$description: Tucking the panel away or bringing it back.

shade.$description: Darkens the sliver of a tucked-away panel, so it reads as set aside.

shade-hover.$description: Lighter on hover: clicking brings the panel back.

handle-width.$description: The tab on the panel's edge that tucks it away and brings it back.

font.$description: Everything in the panel (name, intro, canvas titles, buttons) is set in JetBrains Mono.

border.$description: Edge between the panel and the canvas.

gap.$description: Space between canvases in the list.

current.$description: Ring around the open canvas's snapshot (and the drop line when reordering): a dark gray in light mode, white in dark mode.

rich-text-indent.$description: One indent step (Tab) for a paragraph or heading in rich text.

rich-link.$description: Links inside text and notes: the page's icon, then its title, underlined.

color.$description: Link text: the text color, so a link reads as part of the sentence.

underline.$description: Underline under a link; it darkens to the text color on hover.

connector.$description: Connectors between nodes. Each connector can override its color (separately for light and dark), thickness and label size; these are the defaults.

label-size.$description: Default connector label font size in px.

link.$description: Web page preview cards: an image (Open Graph image or screenshot), then the site and title.

image-bg.$description: Behind the preview image, and the fallback panel when there is none.

padding.$description: Inside the text area below the image.

gap.$description: Between the site row, title and description.

fallback-icon-size.$description: The large icon (or initial) on a card with no preview image.

open-size.$description: Edit mode: the open-in-new-tab button in the card's corner.
